fixStrategies.title: Shorten the first mutable borrow scope
fixStrategies.rationale: End the first mutable borrow before requesting another mutable borrow of the same value.
tradeOffs: Keeps exclusive access clear to the compiler.
May require introducing a smaller block or moving the last use earlier.

fixStrategies.title: Reorder the second mutable operation after the first borrow ends
fixStrategies.rationale: The second mutable borrow is valid once the first mutable reference is no longer used.
tradeOffs: Can change behavior if the two operations were intentionally interleaved.

learnerSummary.whyItMatters: The borrow scopes overlap across an operation boundary, so the second mutable access cannot be proven exclusive.
learnerSummary.nextStep: Shorten the first borrow scope, split the operation into phases, or move the second mutable access behind the first borrow boundary.
